solution:

Trade Balance – The difference between the monetary value of a country's imports and exports in a given period of time is called trade balance. When the value of imports in a year is more than the total value of exports of the country, it is called trade balance deficit and when the value of exports in a year is more than the total value of imports of the country, it is called trade balance surplus.

Actually, due to the rules and regulations of the British at that time, farmers were forced to cultivate indigo on a part of their land instead of food grains. Due to which the condition of the farmers became pitiable.

question: Identify the segment in the sentence which contains the grammatical error. She was unable to produce sufficient evidences for support her accusations.
solution:
उपरोक्त दिए गए वाक्य में sufficient evidences for' के स्थान पर sufficient evidences to'' का प्रयोग होगा। अत: वाक्य में (to + v₁) 'to support' (infinitive) का प्रयोग होगा। 'Evidence' uncountable noun है। अत: इसमें s/es लगाकर इसे plural बनना अशुद्ध है।Correct Sentence- She was unable to produce sufficient evidence to support her accusations.
In the above sentence, instead of 'sufficient evidence for', 'sufficient evidence to' will be used. Hence, (to + v₁) 'to support' (infinitive) will be used in the sentence. 'Evidence' is an uncountable noun. Hence, making it plural by adding s/es to it is incorrect.Correct Sentence- She was unable to produce sufficient evidence to support her accusations.

question:

question:

This scheme is being implemented by three ministries of the government (Ministry of Women and Child Development, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare and Ministry of Human Resources). Which pilgrimage is given the same importance as Gaya for offering Shraddha to ancestors?

solution: पितरों के श्राद्ध के लिए गया जैसा महत्व पेहोवा तीर्थ को दिया जाता है। पेहोवा को पितरों का तीर्थ कहा जाता है। इस स्थल का सम्बन्ध महाभारत के युद्ध से है। यह युद्ध की समाप्ति के बाद पांडवों ने भगवान श्री कृष्ण के साथ मिलकर अपने सगे संबंधियों की आत्मा को शांति पहुंचाने के लिए पेहोवा की धरती पर ही श्राद्ध किया था ।For the shraddha of ancestors, Pehowa Tirtha is given the same importance as Gaya. Pehowa is called the pilgrimage of ancestors. This place is related to the war of Mahabharata. After the end of this war, the Pandavas along with Lord Shri Krishna performed shraddha on the land of Pehowa to give peace to the souls of their relatives.

question:
Who was the ruler of Rewari at the time of Akbar?
अकबर के समय रेवाड़ी के शासक कौन था?
solution: मुगल सम्राट अकबर के समकालीन रेवाड़ी के शासक हेमचन्द्र विक्रमादित्य या हेमू दिल्ली के युद्ध या पानीपत के द्वितीय युद्ध सन् 1556 ई. में हुमांयू/अकबर की सेना के साथ युद्ध किया था। हेमू रेवाड़ी का एक नमक व्यापारी था। अपनी योग्यता के बल पर शेरशाह सूरी के सेना में शामिल हो गया वह सन् 1545-1553 ई. तक शेरशाह सूरी के बेटे इस्लाम शाह का सलाहकार था।Rewari's ruler Hemchandra Vikramaditya or Hemu, a contemporary of Mughal emperor Akbar, fought with Humayun/Akbar's army in the Battle of Delhi or the Second Battle of Panipat in 1556 AD. Hemu was a salt merchant from Rewari. On the basis of his ability, he joined Sher Shah Suri's army. He was an advisor to Sher Shah Suri's son Islam Shah from 1545-1553 AD.

question:
Under whose control was the state of Haryana during 1756-57?

The Marathas took over Haryana in 1756-57. The Third Battle of Panipat was fought on 14 January 1761 at Panipat between the Maratha Empire and Ahmad Shah Abdali of Afghanistan in which the Afghan army was victorious. This victory influenced further Maratha progress and control in the north.

Who had the longest tenure as Governor of Haryana?
हरियाणा में राज्यपाल के रूप में सर्वाधिक कार्यकाल किसका रहा?
solution: हरियाणा में राज्यपाल के रूप सर्वाधिक कार्यकाल बी.एन. चक्रवर्ती का रहा है। इनका कार्यकाल राज्यपाल के रूप में 15 सितम्बर 1967 से 26 मार्च 1976 तक रहा था। हरियाणा के राज्यपाल के रूप में धनिकलाल मंडल का कार्यकाल 07 फरवरी 1990 से 13 जून 1995 तक था। बाबू परमानंद का कार्यकाल 19 जून 2000 से 01 जुलाई 2004 तक था। जय सुखलाल का कार्यकाल 14 अगस्त 1976 से 13 सितम्बर 1977 तक था।B.N. Chakravarti has served the longest tenure as Governor of Haryana. His tenure as Governor was from 15 September 1967 to 26 March 1976. Dhaniklal Mandal's tenure as Governor of Haryana was from 07 February 1990 to 13 June 1995. Babu Parmanand's tenure was from 19 June 2000 to 01 July 2004. Jai Sukhlal's tenure was from 14 August 1976 to 13 September 1977.
